subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, activity source, and authorization semantics should it expose?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but listing phone numbers/sender IDs with permission and activity state changes a security-sensitive admin surface and overlaps existing allowlist, directory, status, and pairing-management paths.

options.title: Design scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 for account-scoped approved-list and revoke commands, and defer group-policy and last-active columns until their privacy model is decided.

options.title: Defer to broader admin UI
options.body: Keep current terminal surfaces unchanged until a broader Control UI or admin model owns contact permission management.

recommendation.title: Design scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across the pairing store, allowlist command, CLI docs/helpers, WhatsApp directory, and security-sensitive channel policy surfaces.
